title: Director of Engineering - Traffic & Networking
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a visionary Director of Traffic and Networking to lead the group responsible for the very circulatory system of our global cloud infrastructure.




THE MISSION

Every query, every login, every byte of data in Snowflake's Data Cloud travels through the systems this team builds. The Traffic & Networking group is responsible for the ingress, egress, domain management, and internal networking layers that connect thousands of customers to Snowflake across public and private connectivity paths. We build and deploy software to enable seamless service-to-service and user-to-service communication across all traffic types spanning every environment and cloud provider Snowflake touches. Your goal is to ensure robust domain management, efficient traffic flow, and reliable connectivity while relentlessly improving product velocity, and operational efficiency.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a senior engineering leader at Snowflake, you will be expected to:

 - Set the Strategic Vision: Define the roadmap for Snowflake’s networking foundation and be accountable for the execution of complex plans and deliverables.

 - Scale Infrastructure: Guide your team in building software solutions that automate and scale networking across multiple cloud providers including AWS, Azure, and GCP.

 - Drive Innovation: Lead projects from initial idea through design and implementation, collaborating with teams in the US, Ireland, Poland, and beyond.

 - Technical Leadership: Provide deep technical expertise with a focus on high-performance, security, and the abstraction of complex cloud networking layers.

 - Build the Team: Actively recruit, hire, and grow a diverse team of industry veterans and rising stars.

 - Mentorship: Be responsible for the career development of your reports through continuous coaching and mentorship.

 - Operational Excellence: Shift resources dynamically to respond to production issues and customer needs, ensuring high levels of reliability.


YOUR PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

We are looking for an exceptional leader who views infrastructure through a product development lens.

 - Experience: 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering management leading leaders.

 - Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven track record in designing systems and managing large-scale production infrastructure with a focus on networking, compute, or storage

 - Cloud Fluency: Strong hands-on experience with cloud service providers.

 - SaaS Background: Deep experience working at scale within a multi-tenant or multi-single-tenant SaaS model, handling billions of complex queries and massive traffic ingress/egress.

 - Communication: Excellent collaboration skills to bridge the gap between complex networking requirements and cross-functional business goals.

 - Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?

 - Impact: You're actively evolving a network architecture, building new observability capabilities, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and designing the next-generation connectivity model across multiple clouds. Every Snowflake team depends on what this group ships. Infrastructure is our product.

 - Growth: This role will push your technical and leadership boundaries in an environment that values practical decision-making and creativity.

 - Security First: You will play a critical role in upholding Snowflake’s high standards for data security and confidentiality.

 - Builder's Culture: We ship our own proxy infrastructure, our own service discovery, our own network automation. This is a build role for someone who wants to own the full traffic stack.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

We're looking for a Staff Security GRC Analyst to build Suno's security compliance program from the ground up. You'll report to our CISO, work alongside our AppSec and InfraSec teams, and own the control framework that ties everything together: which controls we have, how they map to SOC 2 and NIST CSF, and whether they actually work. It's a greenfield build with real stakes and a direct line to leadership.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/8U6fbhqLEghsnRsm




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and own Suno's security control framework, mapping controls to SOC 2, NIST CSF, and future frameworks, and writing control descriptions with the teams who run them.

 - Lead SOC 2 preparation end to end, from gap assessments and readiness tracking to driving remediation with control owners and working with our external auditor.

 - Automate evidence collection and control monitoring with scripts, integrations, and AI tools, deciding where human review stays in the loop.

 - Run vendor security reviews, keep our security policies current, and answer customer security questionnaires alongside Product and Legal.

 - Partner with the CISO to give leadership and the board a clear, evidence-backed view of our security posture, and lay the foundations of GRC as part of a growing Security team.

 - Help earn the trust of the partners and customers who bring Suno to more people, so creating music can be part of everyone's day.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED


MUST-HAVES

 - 7–9 years in GRC, security compliance, or IT audit.

 - Hands-on, end-to-end ownership of a security compliance program as its primary owner, ideally including taking a company through its first SOC 2.

 - Deep working knowledge of SOC 2 and NIST CSF, including control mapping, audit mechanics (design vs. operating effectiveness, sampling, evidence), and staying current as requirements evolve.

 - Enough technical fluency to read a cloud configuration, access setup, or pipeline and judge whether it enforces what the control says. You don't need to write production code.

 - Comfort building your own automation with scripts or AI tools.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience standing up continuous controls monitoring or automated evidence collection, including what it covered and what changed as a result.

 - Experience applying LLMs to assurance work, such as control drafting, framework mapping, or evidence testing.

 - Experience with cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, and with a modern GRC platform.

title: Product Manager, Financial Services
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI is building AI products for serious professional work. We’re going deep on finance with a committed team focused on unlocking the potential of AI in this vertical: working closely with industry experts and users to build bespoke solutions that help finance professionals do real work.

OpenAI’s Financial Services team works closely with customers to understand where AI can improve the economics and quality of financial work: faster diligence, broader research coverage, sharper client materials, more accurate models, and better investment analysis. Our work spans workflows across investment banking, equity research, private equity, asset management, wealth management, insurance, and other parts of finance. We bring together OpenAI’s models, financial data, and enterprise knowledge to build products that fit how financial professionals work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help define and build OpenAI’s financial services products. Reporting to the GM of Financial Services, you will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for key experiences, taking them from customer discovery and early prototypes through launch, adoption, and iteration. This is a hands-on role. You will spend time with bankers, investors, analysts, and other finance professionals; build and test early product experiences; and work closely with Engineering, Design, Research, and customer-facing teams to ship. You should have strong judgment about both the product experience and the work it produces. You will also form a vision for how AI can change the financial services space and can translate that into product execution.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Own product strategy and priorities. Work with the GM to identify the most valuable customer problems and translate them into a clear roadmap. Make decisions about what to build, what to defer, and where partners or shared OpenAI capabilities can best meet the need.

 - Go deep on financial workflows. Sit with customers, observe how they work, and understand the documents they create, data they trust, tools they use, and standards they apply. Use those insights to design experiences that customers return to in their daily work.

 - Build and ship. Create working prototypes, demos, example outputs, and product requirements using Codex and other OpenAI tools. Partner with Engineering and Design to turn early concepts into reliable products, resolve dependencies, and drive delivery through launch and iteration.

 - Raise the bar for quality and trust. Work with Research and Engineering to turn real finance tasks and product failures into evaluations, datasets, and model feedback. Define what good looks like across accuracy, source traceability, completeness, and ease of review, while making practical tradeoffs across quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

 - Make products work inside financial institutions. Translate integration, data-access, privacy, security, and review requirements into product decisions. Work across Legal, Security, Partnerships, and core product teams to address deployment barriers and determine which needs require finance-specific solutions.

 - Measure results and drive adoption. Define success through task completion, output acceptance, repeat usage, time saved, and business impact. Combine product data, evaluations, and customer feedback to guide investment. Partner with GTM and customer-facing teams on pilots, onboarding, and launches, then use what you learn to improve the product.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have a track record of taking complex products from discovery through launch and sustained adoption, as a product manager, founder, or builder with substantial product ownership.

 - Understand financial work well enough to earn credibility with demanding practitioners. You may have built products for financial institutions or worked directly in investment banking, investing, equity research, corporate development, or related fields.

 - Combine strong product taste with attention to detail. You care about making complex workflows feel simple and can judge both the experience and the quality of its outputs.

 - Work comfortably with engineers and researchers on model behavior, data quality, integrations, and evaluations. You can distinguish a model limitation from a data, workflow, or product-design problem.

 - Use AI deeply in your own work and build prototypes to test ideas. You are willing to teach, onboard, debug, and inspect outputs alongside customers.

 What You’ll Need

title: Director, Indirect Tax
description:
Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.

Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.

We're continuing to invest heavily in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for a Director, Indirect Tax to support our mission.



About the Team

The Finance team at Patreon ensures the business runs efficiently, compliantly, and with integrity as we continue to scale globally. Our Tax team owns Patreon's global tax obligations end to end, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and the rest of Finance to build scalable processes that keep pace with a fast-growing, international creator platform.



About the Role

The Director, Indirect Tax is responsible for all indirect taxes across all aspects of the business. Think marketplace sales taxes, ESS, VAT, GST, JCT, etc. This role will be very hands-on and play an integral part in all aspects of tax operations, from collections through remittance. As a Director, you will work closely with Product and Engineering teams as well as the Finance team, to scope, design, and enhance the way our product handles indirect taxes.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Join a small but mighty tax team guiding a fast-growing, world-class Creator-oriented company.

 - Be our expert on all things indirect tax.

 - Lead the preparation of indirect tax returns as well as supporting calculations, work-papers, and payments, ensuring all external deadlines are met.

 - Be able to clearly explain our tax obligations to internal and external stakeholders, and help build a path towards full compliance with those obligations.

 - Act as a first point of contact for organization and Creator/Patron tax queries. Help develop resources to allow Patrons and Creators to understand and comply with tax obligations across the world. Do the best we can to demystify what should be a pain-free and straightforward process.

 - Keep abreast of legislative updates and initiate changes on our platform to ensure compliance.

 - Manage tax controversies, including providing response to various information document requests from tax authorities, coordinate with local tax advisors on reviews, strategize the audit plan and quantify tax/reserve impact to financial statements.

 - Prepare monthly account reconciliations and reporting schedules, providing commentary and variance analysis.

 - Work closely with management and external auditors to ensure the company is compliant with the latest accounting guidance, FAS 5 reserves and SOX.

 - Research and analysis identifying and exploring indirect tax opportunities and exposures related to global footprint expansion, systems and controls, refunds and cash flow management and projections.

 - Be curious. Have a desire to innovate on behalf of Creators worldwide.



About You

 - 10–12+ years experience in indirect tax.

 - Intimate knowledge of VAT/GST and similar transaction taxes.

 - Prior experience with electronically supplied service providers and marketplace providers.

 - Strong experience and knowledge in U.S. GAAP, FAS 5, and internal controls.

 - Experience with informational reporting (Forms 1099, 5471, etc.).

 - Direct prior experience with interpretation and application of developing law.

 - Proven success in tax controversy management and settlement.

 - Previous experience performing tax research and providing technical advice on U.S. state and international tax issues.

 - Self-starter, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and responsibilities.

 - Team leader, able to shepherd projects from beginning to end.

 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 - Detail-oriented and able to effectively organize and manage multiple responsibilities.

 - High level of honesty, integrity, commitment, and responsibility to day-to-day work.

 - Superior written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal skills.

 - Experience with NetSuite; outsourced sales tax providers a plus.

 - Team player, with a positive attitude, who is pro-active and owns accountability.



About Patreon

Patreon powers creators to do what they love and get paid by the people who love what they do. Our team is passionate about making this mission and our core values come to life every day in our work. Through this work, our Patronauts:

 - Put Creators First | They’re the reason we’re here. When creators win, we win.

 - Build with Craft | We sign our name to every deliverable, just like the creators we serve.

 - Make it Happen | We don’t quit. We learn and deliver.

 - Win Together | We grow as individuals. We win as a team.

Patreon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please let us know via email at accommodations@patreon.com.

Patreon offers a competitive benefits package including and not limited to salary, equity plans, healthcare, flexible time off, company holidays and recharge days, commuter benefits, lifestyle stipends, learning and development stipends, patronage, parental leave, and 401k plan with matching.

Patreon operates under a hybrid work model, where employees based in office locations are expected to come into the office three days per week, excluding sick time and paid leave. The goal of this policy is to be intentional about the in-person time we spend together to strengthen the feeling of community at Patreon. Candidates hired into remote-eligible roles are not expected to meet the same requirements.

At Patreon, we believe in fair and transparent pay. In compliance with New York and California pay transparency laws, we are sharing the expected salary range for this role.

The posted salary range is dependent on the location and the level. This range may encompass multiple levels within the role’s job family. The final offer will be based on candidate’s experience, skills, competencies, and geographic location, aligning with the appropriate job level within Patreon’s leveling framework. For remote employees located outside CA and NY, salary may vary based on location and local market conditions.

Autonomous agents require more than just models; they require a high-fidelity, low-latency state layer to reason, act, and persist context. This role is not about building traditional data processing pipelines or legacy ETL/ELT workflows; it is about building the core distributed systems and atomic primitives that make those agentic workflows possible.

In this role, you will be a lead architect of the Snowflake Data Transformation Engine. You will design and implement the fundamental transformations infrastructure—Stateful Stream Processing Engines, Incremental View Maintenance Engine, Materialization Internals, and the Distributed Orchestration Fabric. Our solid foundation supporting the seamless transition for enterprises between batch and streaming through Dynamic Tables, Streams & Tasks, and DBT Projects is the starting point. Your architectural work will extend the reach of the core engine to accelerate and support the massive scale of the Snowpark and Spark ecosystems. You are building the systems that allow both data engineers and autonomous agents to process exabytes of data with sub-second state propagation and absolute transactional integrity across the Snowflake Data Cloud.

As a Principal Engineer II, you will own the technical vision for the Data Transformation umbrella of capabilities. Your work on streaming internals and declarative state management provides the architectural substrate for high-performance customer features processing. This foundational technology is engineered to drive low-latency, high-throughput data transformations at a massive scale to empower enterprises to build and scale complex applications, including autonomous agentic loops. This infrastructure enables our broader ecosystem to operate on live, governed data, ensuring that the core engine primitives we build translate directly into superior data freshness and processing efficiency for every customer.

 - Displace Legacy Orchestration Layers: Identify how to build superior, native processing capabilities directly within the Snowflake engine to eliminate the complexity of external schedulers, simplifying the architectural scaffolding for our customers.

 - Engineer for Global Scale and Governance: Design and implement highly reliable, multi-tenant system internals that handle exabytes of data while maintaining Snowflake’s industry-leading standards for resource isolation, security, and distributed consistency.

 - Drive Technical Strategy for the AI Era: Provide technical leadership to senior management and multiple departments, influencing how Snowflake’s core compute fabric evolves to support the burgeoning Model Context Protocol (MCP), autonomous agent ecosystems and modern Python and Spark data processing workflows.

 - Drive Customer Success through Direct Engagement: Partner with Snowflake’s most strategic customers and field engineering teams to translate massive-scale architectural challenges into core engine requirements, ensuring our processing primitives meet the real-world demands of the global Data Cloud.

 - Ensure Operational Excellence: Take responsibility for the operational readiness of the services, meeting the strict commitments to our customers regarding reliability, availability, and performance.


OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER II WILL HAVE:

title: Sr. Director, GTM Process & Operations
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


THE POSITION



Snowflake is seeking a Sr. Director, GTM Process & Operations to own our global GTM operating model, reporting to the SVP of Revenue Strategy and Operations. This executive role defines how Snowflake's revenue motion runs — setting business priorities and processes, leading AI and automation adoption across GTM workflows, and standardizing the Quote-to-Cash and field support functions that directly drive revenue velocity. You will own the operating cadence that connects GTM strategy to execution, lead cross-functional alignment across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Partner Operations, and manage a global team of Directors, Senior Managers, and specialists across QTC, Core Sales, and Shared Services.



As a key leader in Snowflake's AI-native RevOps evolution, you will inherit a highly capable team and push it further — ensuring Snowflake's own revenue operations are the best proof point for Snowflake's technology.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



GTM Business Strategy & Operating Model
Own GTM business priorities, processes, policies, and operating metrics across the revenue motion. Define field requirements and translate GTM strategy into clear business cases and outcome targets. Drive the operating cadence that connects strategy to execution.

AI & Automation Adoption
Lead GTM's adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows within business processes. Build and test AI solutions in the context of GTM operations — own adoption rates and business results. Partner with ET for the platforms, security, controls, integration, and production support that make those solutions reliable and scalable.

Revenue Velocity
Standardize global sales workflows and streamline Quote-to-Cash to reduce cycle times and field friction. Own the business process layer; partner with ET to ensure the underlying data and systems are fast, reliable, and trusted enough for field leaders to act on without verification overhead.

Field Support
Provide strategic leadership for the Field Support organization, integrating specialized deal support with centralized operational execution to optimize field productivity and customer success.

Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with ET, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Partner Operations to scope GTM capabilities and define investment priorities. Provide clear business requirements and outcomes accountability; partner with ET for architecture, technical standards, and delivery. Avoid creating duplicate decision rights or additional translation layers between the business and technology.

Team Leadership
Manage and grow a global team of Directors, Senior Managers, and specialists across QTC, Core Sales, and Shared Services. Build a product-led culture — one where your team works directly with business users, understands their problems deeply, and drives adoption without requiring intermediary layers.

Snowflake on Snowflake
Serve as the business partner and proving ground for Snowflake's own AI and data capabilities. Represent GTM requirements and adoption outcomes; partner with ET, Product, and Data Engineering — who lead the technology work — to embed Snowflake's capabilities into internal GTM workflows.

 
 


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 15+ years of professional experience, with 8+ years leading Sales Operations, GTM Operations, or Revenue Strategy functions in a high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment

 - Proven success managing global, multi-layered teams across process design, field enablement, and SLA-driven shared services operations

 - Deep expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (SFDC, CPQ, CLM) and how it supports GTM business processes

 - Experience defining business requirements and outcome metrics that drive technology investment decisions in partnership with IT or Engineering counterparts

 - Demonstrated ability to drive executive alignment through data, manage competing priorities, and communicate across technical and business audiences

 
 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience leading a GTM operations team through an AI adoption transition — owning field adoption, business results, and use case validation, with technology delivery handled by a partner organization

 - Track record of working directly with business users without intermediary layers — building credibility as both a domain expert and an operational partner

 - Demonstrated ownership of operating metrics, field productivity programs, or a GTM transformation initiative where business outcomes were the primary measure of success

 - Experience translating ambiguous GTM strategy into structured requirements that a technical team can architect and deliver against

 - Executive presence and credibility with peer VPs and SVPs — able to represent the business clearly and hold the line on requirements without drifting into technology ownership
   
   Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate – not incrementally, but end-to end. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. As we scale, our Enterprise Product organization sits at the center of this mission — connecting the systems our customers use, and scaling into new customer segments & verticals.



We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong technical foundation and the ability to own and solve complex product and commercial challenges end-to-end. This person will focus on building out integrations with strategic partners and vendors as well as enable search over data source using MCP’s and deep research. You will help architect systems to bring legal context into Harvey and also work with our Partnerships org and internal teams to prioritize which ones to build. This role is equal parts product intuition and technical execution. You’ll be trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions, ship impactful features, work on the cutting edge of applied AI and grow a team that embodies engineering excellence



We move with urgency, bias toward simplicity, and expect our leaders to be hands-on when needed. If you’re energized by ownership, decisive execution, and solving real user problems, we'd love to hear from you.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use an in-person work model (3 days a week) and offer relocation assistance to new employees.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and strategy to execution and launch

 - Collaborate closely with engineering and partnerships team to identify and execute on high-impact integrations

 - Work closely with engineers to build, platformize and scale integrations, working cross functionally with adjacent teams

 - Expand the breadth and depth of integrations into the Harvey platform

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Engineering, Applied AI, Research, and Platform teams to deliver high-quality production systems that support reasoning, summarization, and legal research workflows.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of experience building enterprise products in a B2B/commercial environment

 - Experience working on Integrations and partnering with cross functional and Partnerships teams

 - Experience with or knowledge of AI and LLMs

 - Ability to partner with engineers on technical architecture, with enough depth to challenge assumptions, propose solutions, and influence design.

 - Ability to navigate extreme ambiguity to deliver outcomes

 - A product mindset for balancing user needs, domain complexity, and system constraints to propose high-leverage improvements.




COMPENSATION RANGE

$215,000 - $300,000 USD
